newsitem.title: FRANCE: French police hold man after explosives threat.
newsitem.headline: French police hold man after explosives threat.

text.p: French police arrested a man on Tuesday after a brief drama in which he chained himself to a railing outside the Paris law courts and said his suitcase was stuffed with explosives, police said.
It was not immediately clear whether his case did in fact contain explosives. Police had sealed off the area after he chained himself to the railings in early evening.
The man wanted to meet the head of the Supreme Court because of a legal dispute.
The law courts are on the Ile de la Cite, an island in the river Seine which is also the site of Notre-Dame cathedral.
